History of Present Illness:
25-year-old man. Twenty hours of pain migrating from the central abdomen to the right lower quadrant, with nausea. He has not measured a fever.

Physical Examination:
Right lower-quadrant tenderness with localized rebound. Temperature 37.1 C; heart rate 88/min; BP 128/74 mmHg; respiratory rate 20/min; SpO2 97% on room air.

Laboratory Tests:
WBC: 9.4 10^9/L (reference 4.0-11.0)
Hemoglobin: 13.5 g/dL (reference 12.0-17.5)
Platelets: 290 10^9/L (reference 150-400)
Sodium: 137 mmol/L (reference 135-145)
Potassium: 3.9 mmol/L (reference 3.5-5.0)
Creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (reference 0.6-1.3)
CRP: 135 mg/L (reference <5)
Lipase: 42 U/L (reference 13-60)
ALT: 32 U/L (reference 7-45)
AST: 27 U/L (reference 10-40)
Alkaline phosphatase: 105 U/L (reference 40-130)
Total bilirubin: 0.7 mg/dL (reference 0.2-1.2)

Imaging Findings:
CT abdomen/pelvis: 9 mm fluid-filled appendix with adjacent fat stranding and trace localized fluid. No collection.
